def transform_ties(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    background=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    objects=[(color,cells,mod._bbox(cells)) for color,cells in mod._components(grid) if color!=background]
    markers=[(obj,mod._corner(obj[1])) for obj in objects]
    markers=[(obj,corner) for obj,corner in markers if corner is not None]
    if not markers:return out
    (mc,ms,mb),corner=max(markers,key=lambda x:len(x[0][1]))
    inside=[obj for obj in objects if obj[1]!=ms and mod._inside(obj[2],mb)]
    outside=[obj for obj in objects if obj[1]!=ms and mod._disjoint(obj[2],mb)]
    targets=set()
    for scol,scells,sbox in inside:
        pattern=mod._shape(scells)
        exact=[obj for obj in outside if mod._shape(obj[1])==pattern]
        if len(exact)!=1:continue
        target=exact[0]
        sq,tq=mod._quadrant(sbox,corner),mod._quadrant(target[2],corner)
        if len(pattern)>1 and tq==(-sq[0],-sq[1]):
            dq=(sq[0],-sq[1])
            fr=[obj for obj in outside if obj[0]==scol and mod._is_subshape(obj[1],scells) and mod._quadrant(obj[2],corner)==dq]
            if fr:
                largest=max(len(obj[1]) for obj in fr)
                best=[obj for obj in fr if len(obj[1])==largest]
                targets.update(cell for obj in best for cell in obj[1])
                continue
        targets.update(target[1])
    for r,c in targets:out[r][c]=mc
    return out
